# Fire Industry Association (FIA)

> > The Fire Industry Association (FIA) is the UK's leading trade association for the fire protection industry, providing guidance on fire safety legislation, standards like BS 5839, and professional development.

FIA represents fire safety professionals, installers, and manufacturers across the UK. The organization works closely with bodies like the London Fire Brigade, CFOA, and government to promote compliance with the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 and advance fire protection standards.

## Key Topics

- Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 (RR(FS)O)
- Fire Industry Association (FIA)
- Fire risk assessment
- BS 5839 fire detection standards
- Fire safety training and professional development
- London Fire Brigade
- Chief Fire Officers Association (CFOA)
- Fire and Rescue Services
- Ken Knight report (Facing the Future)
- Emergency voice communication systems
- Fire safety legislation and compliance
- Waste recycling centre fire protection
- Fire extinguisher maintenance
- Fire safety conferences and seminars
